attacker_is_builder_admin.meaning: the attacker holds the builderAdmin role at the time sweep() is invoked

wallet_token_balance.meaning: total token balance held by the BuilderWallet contract

tokens_drained.meaning: all tokens are drained from the BuilderWallet via sweep(), causing loss of funds

assumptions: The attacker obtains the builderAdmin role by calling init() before invoking sweep().
sweep() transfers tokens held by BuilderWallet to the caller when the caller is builderAdmin.
The report describes the drain as a capability; whether tokens are present at attack time is not fixed.

unresolved.description: Report does not state sweep()'s authorization rule beyond the attacker holding builderAdmin, so the exact guard bypassed by the takeover is not defined.
No prior state of builderAdmin (unset vs. set) before init() is given, so the takeover precondition cannot be pinned to a specific prior value.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the funds_drained impact; the separate builderAdmin takeover impact is not covered by this claim.
The condition encodes the concrete incident subcase (attacker holds builderAdmin and calls sweep) rather than a general unauthorized-caller scope, because the report only establishes that subcase.
No numeric token amount is bound; wallet_token_balance is declared but the drain relation is expressed at the all-tokens-drained Boolean level.
